status: Design applicability inventory, not a compliance matrix or implementation authorization.
rule: Named standards inform design unless a separately selected profile defines applicable normative provisions, implementation scope and verification. Empty provisions means clause review pending, not no obligations.

entries.reviewBasis: Official public abstract/catalogue only; full normative clauses not reviewed. Published 2018 edition is current; ISO reports a forthcoming replacement.
designQuestions: Can requirements retain independent identity, source/rationale and verification context?
Can typed traces distinguish reference support from execution evidence?
entries.verificationPlan: Review chosen applicable clauses from authorized normative text; map each to exact Tracer criteria and evidence before any conformance claim.
gaps: No process or tool conformance established

entries.reviewBasis: Official specification index and normative artifact availability; no complete interchange mapping or implementation reviewed.
designQuestions: How will identities, typed attributes, relationships, hierarchy and unsupported contextual-reference data map to ReqIF?
Which data is outside the interchange profile and how will any loss be disclosed?
entries.verificationPlan: Before selecting ReqIF delivery, define a versioned supported profile and normative mapping, validate files against its schemas, test representative cross-tool round trips and report unsupported/lost semantics.
gaps: No ReqIF import/export implementation or conformance target selected
Core recorded-project JSON export is not ReqIF
Full history and evaluation evidence must not be promised through an unreviewed exchange mapping

entries.edition: W3C Web Annotation Data Model, Recommendation 2017-02-23
entries.reviewBasis: Primary specification source/selector/state and textual selector sections reviewed.
designQuestions: Are resource identity, selected part and selected state distinct?
Are unsupported or ambiguous selectors preserved without silent scope broadening?
entries.verificationPlan: Exercise typed selector/state round-trip preservation and unknown/ambiguous resolution; richer selector support remains a separately selected capability.
gaps: No W3C annotation serialization/profile conformance claimed
No automatic reanchoring or content retention guarantee

entries.reviewBasis: Primary specification qualified usage and provenance-role patterns reviewed.
designQuestions: Can captured content state, native interpretation/reference and the activity using them remain separately identifiable?
Are actor/time/outcome and explicitly declared usage roles retained without implying content ownership?
entries.verificationPlan: Inspect explicit input role/state capture, immutable outcome and actor/time provenance; distinguish relation role from resource classification.
gaps: No PROV RDF/OWL serialization or interchange conformance claimed
Native records/resources do not automatically map one-to-one to PROV classes

entries.reviewBasis: Official Core/RM overview and RM conformance boundary reviewed.
designQuestions: Can stable source identities and locators be mapped without coupling native identity to a URL?
entries.verificationPlan: Select client/server capabilities and applicable normative Core/RM requirements only with an actual integration slice.
gaps: No OSLC endpoint/client implementation or conformance selected
HTTP API and stable identifiers alone do not establish OSLC conformance

entries.reviewBasis: Official public scope summaries; normative clauses not reviewed.
designQuestions: Can the configurable model support engineering activities without imposing one universal lifecycle?
entries.verificationPlan: Tailor applicable process outcomes deliberately if a project adopts these standards; keep process evidence separate from product behavior.

entries.reviewBasis: Official public quality-model and secure-development guidance summaries. SSDF edition/status must be selected explicitly for any detailed mapping.
designQuestions: Are relevant product-quality and security requirements explicit and testable for each selected slice?
entries.verificationPlan: Use as review prompts; select exact applicable quality/security criteria and checks rather than adding blanket compliance requirements.
gaps: No product-quality certification or SSDF assessment

designQuestions: Can semantic relationship mappings remain meaningful without adopting the entire modeling language?
entries.verificationPlan: Specify any future mapping/API capability independently, with declared supported scope.
gaps: No SysML language/API implementation or conformance selected
